assertion.statement: For the actual imaginary quadratic K, O_(K,S_T)* modulo squares has F2 dimension1+|S_T|.
assertion.objects: The actual imaginary quadratic field and its finite S_T-unit group.
assertion.hypotheses: K is imaginary quadratic; its ordinary class group is finite; S_T is finite.
assertion.quantifiers: Each permitted K and S_T in the residual estimate.
assertion.parameter_range: Residual scalar coefficients F2, before doubling to W=F2^2.
assertion.uniformity: Exact sequence for the same actual support.
assertion.normalizations: The rank is |S_T| and the finite cyclic roots of unity contribute one squareclass.
assertion.exceptional_cases: This does not bound the two-rank of the S-class group; that is the subsequent local genus argument.
assertion.limit_order: Use ordinary unit rank zero and class-group finiteness. The valuation image of S-units is finite index in Z^(S_T), since each prime ideal has a principal power; then reduce the resulting finitely generated group modulo squares.

use.reason: Uses ordinary units and finite class group to derive the S-unit rank at the exact support.
